purpose: Repair the proven invalid production Web server API authority for the registration-critical staff control plane without weakening auth, MFA, CSRF, role, tenant or database controls.
acceptance: the owner-only command runs only on release issue 3072 and binds exact current main
the active API and Web revisions are equal, are ancestors of current main, and the deployed Web source contains the hardened canonical server API resolver
the pre-mutation active Web API_URL is classified without publishing its value and mutation is allowed only for the proven invalid-origin state
the candidate Compose override changes only web.environment.API_URL to the exact canonical internal authority http://api:3001
the candidate Web image resolves to the same local image ID as the running Web container before recreation
only Web is recreated with --no-deps --no-build --pull never and all non-Web container IDs remain unchanged
the post-repair active Web authority is exact canonical and anonymous internal /auth/me plus /staff/capabilities/me both return 401
API and Web OCI revisions remain equal to the pre-mutation deployed revision
any post-mutation failure restores the prior override state and recreates Web from the pre-repair Compose configuration
no API_URL value, credential, protected path, container ID, Compose project name or raw logs are published
